text: Portland Open Studios starts this Saturday and Sunday, Oct 10-11, with a free, self-guided tour of 100+ local artists' studios from 10 to 4. I might wander through a few if the weather's kind. If your week has been a long one, a slow weekend looking at other people's cool work might be a nice reset.
why: Portland Open Studios, a free self-guided artist studio tour on Oct 10-11 and 17-18, 10 am to 4 pm.
instagram:
Portland Open Studios kicks off Saturday and Sunday, Oct 10-11, from 10 to 4, and again the next weekend. It's a free, self-guided tour of artists' studios around the city, in everything from living rooms to old warehouses. I might poke around a few if I can pick a route without getting hopelessly lost. Hope your week's been gentle, friends.

text: The Chicago Marathon is next Sunday, Oct 11, and I'm getting a little nostalgic about the big, loud, kind-hearted crowds that line the course. Good luck to everyone running, and to everyone out there clapping for strangers. Hope your week is going okay, friends. 🙂
why: Nostalgic, friendly shout-out to the Chicago Marathon on Sunday, Oct 11, 2026.
instagram:
Chicago Marathon day is next Sunday, Oct 11, with the start at 7:20 a.m. downtown. Something like 53,000 runners are expected, and I'm feeling nostalgic about the whole city turning out to cheer for people they've never met. Sending good thoughts to every runner, every volunteer, and every sign-holder. Anyone else miss that kind of energy?
